observations.definition: One uninterrupted pnpm check:foundation run from a clean candidate worktree; no isolated rerun substitutes for this observation.
The complete contiguous 45-60 second selected window at 60 fps, all acts, every transition, restrained passage, build, peak, and resolution. Exact ranges are materialized in the Gate 1 treatment.

Start and final frame, one representative midpoint per act, pre/mid/post frames for every transition, restrained passage, build, and primary peak. Exact frames are frozen in the Gate 1 treatment before deep implementation.
Every review-frame-set frame plus one frame immediately before and after each cue and act boundary; three repeated evaluations per path.
Three-second warm-up followed by one complete graph-closed production pass and one complete graph-open production pass; record every displayed interval and runtime sample.
Twelve sustained pointer samples against one graph-bound continuous control while the full flagship plays graph-open, followed by one release, undo, and redo.
Three cold and three warm seeks to every determinism-frame-set frame, including all act and transition boundaries.
Six complete cycles covering playback, graph-open edit, seek, model load, still render, project close/reopen, and disposal, with forced GC before the first and after the final sample.
The complete 1920x1080 60 fps H.264/AAC output, decoded video frames, decoded audio stream, and all treatment-declared intentional hold/black/white/silence intervals.
One bundle validate/open/edit/save/reopen/rerender workflow in a fresh network-disabled profile with empty task-specific caches.
Gate 1 treatment, Gate 2 provisional language, Gate 3 structure, Gate 4 motion/visual lock, and Gate 5 final video plus editable-project review.

decisionRules.definition: All declared counts, ranges, identities, bindings, active intervals, consumers, and required roles are present; count-only, invisible, duplicate, disabled, or unused structures fail.

Discrete values and issue sets are exact; finite numeric values use absolute 0.000001 and relative 0.000001 tolerance; project, revision, execution manifest, cue, layer, graph-output, resolved-parameter, readiness, and issue identities must agree.

Pinned-device repeated decoded frames require SSIM >= 0.995 and normalized mean absolute error <= 0.006; audio stream identity is exact and A/V start/duration drift is <= one 60 fps frame (16.667 ms). Encoded bytes need not match.

Flag black or clipped-white runs >= 0.5 s, perceptual freeze runs >= 1.0 s, silence below -60 dBFS >= 1.0 s, discontinuities, clipping, z-fighting, popping, or missing resources. A flag passes only when its exact interval and intent were approved in the Gate 1 treatment.

Displayed FPS >= 58; interval p95 <= 20 ms; intervals > 33.33 ms <= 1%; intervals > 100 ms = 0; runtime planning p95 <= 5 ms; total runtime CPU p95 <= 12 ms; graph-open FPS no worse than 10% below graph-closed; graph/layer/compositor/renderer costs are recorded where truthfully available; full content and quality 2 remain enabled.
Pointer-to-transient p95 <= 1.0 ms; pointer-to-visible p95 <= 32 ms; movement revisions = 0; release revisions = 1; undo and redo each restore the exact expected state.
Every seek reaches the semantic-equivalent target frame; seek-to-visible p95 <= 100 ms, maximum <= 250 ms, and no target has more than one sample > 100 ms across its six repetitions.

The complete 1920x1080 quality-2 60 fps render sustains at least 5 encoded output frames per wall-clock second and completes in no more than 12 times the selected media duration, with no disabled content.

Six cycles show no monotonic renderer object, texture, target, program, model lease, subscription, canvas, or audio-resource growth; forced-GC heap growth < 16 MiB; final display p95 <= 110% of initial p95.
Existing Light Tunnel budgets remain: FPS >= 59, display p95 <= 20 ms, planning p95 <= 5 ms, total runtime CPU p95 <= 12 ms, intervals >33.33 ms = 0, long tasks = 0, temporal issues = 0.
No unexpected browser console error/warning, page error, runtime issue, missing/unready resource, invalid graph, unresolved binding, or failed job remains during the declared workflow.
The exact command exits 0 without retries, weakened tests, threshold overrides, suppressed warnings, disabled content, or unexplained skips.
The named human reviewer explicitly approves the exact artifact and records requested changes or approval; silence, inference, or an automated aesthetic score fails.

Review finds one project/session/runtime/compositor meaning, no flagship identity or timestamp in generic core, no agent shadow semantics, no React frame-rate truth, no long-lived bridge, and no unproven abstraction.

Candidate C is a clean immutable commit containing all behavior; evidence E is a later documentation-only commit identifying C, artifacts, results, and approvals; any behavioral change after C invalidates C.

criteria.requirement: The contiguous production is 45-60 seconds at 60 fps with 4-6 perceptibly distinct acts, at least 3 transitions, a restrained passage, build, primary peak, and resolved ending anchored to the musical map.

The editable project honestly uses approximately 8-12 meaningful enabled layers, at least 4 component families, several simultaneous peak layers, and multiple responsibility-separated graphs; every counted item has a nonredundant role, active interval, and visible or inspectable contribution.
Model-backed 3D and authored animation make a visible, deterministic, grounded contribution with declared clip and asset identities.

evaluation.workflow: Review model-backed passages, direct seeks, and transition clips at Gates 2-5; inspect grounding, animation readability, identity, and continuity.

criteria.requirement: A procedural or spatial 3D system has a distinct visible responsibility and deterministic runtime behavior.

evaluation.workflow: Review declared procedural/spatial passages and isolated contribution evidence at Gates 2-5.

criteria.requirement: Shader-driven and bounded particle or instanced contributions are visible, deterministic, resource-bounded, and creatively nonredundant.

evaluation.workflow: Review isolated and composited shader/particle passages plus lifecycle evidence at Gates 2-5.

criteria.requirement: A complementary 2D, SVG, image, video, graphic, or typography contribution has a meaningful compositional role.

evaluation.workflow: Review the declared complementary-media role in representative stills and motion at Gates 2-5.

criteria.requirement: Compositor ordering, opacity, transforms, blends, directed camera behavior, foreground/mid/background hierarchy, density, negative space, and transitions form one legible composition.

evaluation.workflow: Inspect one frame per act, every transition clip, camera trajectory, and full motion proxy at Gates 2-5.

criteria.requirement: Macro, phrase, and detail reactivity are intentionally authored; each major graph output names its musical/directorial intent and rate/phase semantics remain distinct.

evaluation.workflow: Review musical map, graph-output intent report, full proxy, and peak/transition clips at Gates 1-5.

criteria.requirement: No unresolved asset, rig, grounding, clipping, z-fighting, popping, freeze, black, clipped-white, silence, or motion-discontinuity defect remains outside approved treatment intervals.
The exact final video is explicitly approved as one coherent, polished work with a recognizable identity distinct from Signal Cathedral and Afterlight Assembly.

evaluation.workflow: Watch the complete exact candidate video with intended audio and inspect the reopened editable project at Gate 5.

criteria.requirement: Headless inspection, revision-safe mutation, seek, checkpoint, bake, render, diagnosis, and refinement use canonical project/session/job/inspection contracts.
The same canonical project and live session operated by the agent are visible and editable in the preserved editor without polling or shadow state.
Agent changes appear once in canonical history with actor attribution and participate in conflict handling, undo, and redo.
Continuous human editing has immediate transient and visible response, zero movement revisions, exactly one release commit, undo, redo, save, close, and reopen.
No agent-only project, mutation, renderer, output, graph, transport, audio, history, or runtime semantics exist.

evaluation.workflow: Review package dependencies, public control operations, production package imports, and full candidate diff.

criteria.requirement: Sequential, cold, direct-seek, checkpoint-replay, and repeated evaluation agree at every declared act and transition frame.
Preview, still, video, and render-adapter paths assign the same semantic meaning at every declared frame.
Repeated pinned renders meet decoded-frame equivalence and exact stream/audio synchronization rules; encoded byte identity is not claimed.
A clean network-disabled environment validates, resolves, opens, edits, saves, reopens, and rerenders the portable bundle without absolute workstation paths or undeclared caches.
Project, runtime, capability pack, component, node, renderer, asset, artifact, source, and output identities and hashes are pinned in the execution and certification manifests.
The exact flagship passes playback, pause, seek, loop, graph inspection, parameter editing, history, persistence, Jobs, Rhythm Lab, diagnostics, profiler, still, and video workflows.
Graphs and runtime debug values animate during playback without React as the signal bus, and ordinary-use console/runtime diagnostics remain clean.
Layer, graph, output, asset, artifact, and component responsibilities are understandable in the editor without source archaeology.

evaluation.workflow: Inspect the complete reopened project structure at Gates 3 and 5 without consulting source code.

criteria.requirement: All 42 V1 parity capabilities remain verified or have an explicit human-approved change with current evidence.
The exact full flagship meets graph-closed and graph-open display cadence budgets with full Gate 3 content enabled at quality 2.
Graph-open continuous editing meets transient, visible, revision, undo, and redo budgets under the full flagship load.
Cold and warm seeks across every act and transition boundary are correct, measured, and free of recurring stalls.
Six full edit/playback/model/render/reopen cycles have stable cadence, heap, subscriptions, and renderer resources.
Every new retained program proves bounded allocation, lease ownership, disposal, and return to steady state.
The exact full-duration 1920x1080 quality-2 H.264/AAC render meets the frozen minimum throughput without content or quality reduction.
The exact previously certified Light Tunnel project retains its stronger planning, playback, graph-open, interaction, and temporal-issue floor.
Every promoted capability names its governing package/spec and proves two different consumers or the documented stable-boundary exception with an independent fixture.

evaluation.workflow: Review the promotion report, dependency graph, consumers, fixtures, and governing contracts for every promoted capability.

criteria.requirement: Production score, palette, choreography, assets, graphs, and timestamps remain outside generic engine core; generic packages never import or recognize the flagship.
New authoring, inspection, comparison, and feedback surfaces wrap the same canonical operations used by editor, CLI, and hosts, with source and built-package agreement.
Temporary scaffolding, duplicate paths, bridges, unused configuration, debug artifacts, dead source, and production-only canonical-tool duplicates are removed.

evaluation.workflow: Review the complete candidate diff, source tree, package boundaries, generated artifacts, comments, and deletion opportunities.

criteria.requirement: Signal Cathedral and Afterlight Assembly project, deterministic runtime, bundle, and production suites remain green.
Every new semantic and reusable capability has focused correctness, invalid-input, cancellation, missing-resource, and lifecycle coverage appropriate to its contract.
Parity, architecture, format, lint, types, all deterministic tests, all active browser journeys, all packages, Studio, and consumer smokes pass in one uninterrupted run.
Every active mandatory browser journey passes; every opt-in/environment-limited journey has an explicit reason, command, environment, and required run record rather than an unexplained skip.

The approved treatment records track/window provenance, frame-exact sections, phrases, events, energy, contrast, camera/composition cues, 4-6 act arc, visual language, roles, review frames, targets, risks, exclusions, and non-goals.

evaluation.workflow: Review and explicitly approve the complete treatment and musical map at Gate 1.

criteria.requirement: Source/derived asset provenance, deterministic audio artifacts, canonical project, portable bundle, trusted capability manifest, and pinned execution manifest exist with immutable hashes and reproduction commands.
Review evidence contains representative stills for every act, a 12-16-frame whole-production contact sheet, and focused clips for every transition and the primary peak.
The exact candidate output is 1920x1080, 60 fps, H.264/AAC with intended audio, correct duration and synchronization, plus a media probe and automated visual/audio sanity report.
Determinism/reopen/rerender, performance/endurance, graph/compositor/model/runtime inspection, agent activity/friction, and reusable-promotion reports exist and map findings to immutable identities.
Gate 1 through Gate 5 decisions identify exact reviewed artifacts, approval or requested changes, reviewer, date, and resulting candidate identity where applicable.

evaluation.workflow: Record each explicit human calibration decision against immutable artifact identities in the final certification evidence.

criteria.requirement: A clean independently reproducible candidate commit C passes every behavioral criterion, and a later documentation-only evidence commit E records C, artifacts, results, and explicit Gate 5 approval.
